**Finding: Compliant** (rule MFN, § 7.6, paragraph p0031)

The document contains one MFN provision, and it benefits us: Brightline warrants that Fees charged to Northwind will be no less favourable than fees offered to similarly situated customers for comparable volumes and terms. I checked the Fees/Invoicing section, Order Forms, and General for any reciprocal or Customer-side "best terms"/match-a-third-party-offer obligation and found none. That satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline was proposed — a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and should be kept as drafted.
